ModDescription: Standalone auto-loadout virtual sigil slots for Granblue Fantasy: Relink Endless Ragnarok. Applies a fixed template loadout (e.g. Guts V+ / Autorevive V+) to characters at runtime without touching save data or inventory. Derived from GBFR.ExtraSigilSlots (Hiyajomaho-num9) with the selector UI, Overlay Broker, input capture, and preset machinery removed.
